title: escutcheon — mansion

translations.translation: 有花纹的盾, 锁眼盖, 孔罩

sentences.sentence: The progress of the bloom was checked closely by museum horticulturalist Zac Stayton.
sentences.translation: 博物馆的园艺学家扎克•斯泰顿严密监测着开花的过程。

sentences.sentence: Father-of-three Mr England, who works as a RHS horticulturalist and lives in Lockleaze, Bristol, was stunned because wild squirrels are usually highly secretive animals.
sentences.translation: 史蒂夫·英格兰先生有三个孩子，他是皇家园艺学会的园艺师，目前居住在布里斯托尔的Lockleaze。 当时他被眼前的情景惊呆了，因为通常情况下，野生松鼠的行踪高度诡秘。

sentences.sentence: I'm a professional horticulturalist, and I'm excited about the topic of ornamenting one's garden and teaching others how best to accomplish this.
sentences.translation: 我是专业的园艺家，我对装饰花园，及教导别人如何完成装饰花园等主题，十分感兴趣。

sentences.sentence: For example, you could list your records in your report alphabetically.
sentences.translation: 例如，可以在报告中按字母顺序列出记录。

sentences.sentence: Some options led to a second list of recipes organized alphabetically or by most recent entry.
sentences.translation: 一些选项指向按字母顺序或者按最近访问组织的另一个菜谱列表。

sentences.sentence: You can sort the rows within a table of data according to the data type, allowing you to order by figures — alphabetically and by date.
sentences.translation: 您还可以根据数据类型对数据表格中的行进行排序，这样便可以按数字、字母和日期进行排序。

sentences.sentence: He carelessly left the door unlocked.
sentences.translation: 他很粗心，没锁上门。

sentences.sentence: "Oh," he said carelessly. "I'm in no hurry to get back."
sentences.translation: "哦，"他漫不经心地说道，"我不急着回去。"

sentences.sentence: Jeff: If you were a supermodel, I can see why that would be important.
sentences.translation: 杰夫：如果你是一个超级名模我就明白为什么这很重要。

sentences.sentence: British supermodel Naomi Campbell has interviewed Venezuela's President Hugo Chavez, describing him as a "rebel angel" who is unafraid to speak his mind but poses no threat to democracy.
sentences.translation: 英国超级名模娜奥米·坎贝尔日前采访了委内瑞拉总统胡戈·查韦斯，她称查韦斯为“叛逆天使”，因为他完全不惧恐吓，坚持自己的理念。

sentences.sentence: Some of the celebrities, including actress Eva Mendes and supermodel Cindy Crawford appeared in a "Stars Without Makeup" section in which they were photographed wearing no make-up for their close-ups.
sentences.translation: 其他一些名人，如女演员伊娃·曼德斯和超级名模辛迪·克劳馥德等出现在“不施粉黛最美人物”单元，这些明星在近距离拍照时不化妆。

sentences.sentence: The stubble was burning in the fields.
sentences.translation: 残株在田地里燃烧着。

sentences.sentence: Scholarships are given solely on the basis of financial need.
sentences.translation: 奖学金完全是根据经济需要发放的。

sentences.sentence: I shall hold you solely responsible for anything that goes wrong.
sentences.translation: 出现任何差错的话，我唯你是问。

sentences.sentence: ...illegal campers who persist in flouting the law.
sentences.translation: …一向无视法律的非法露营者。

translations.translation: 吉娃娃(一种产于墨西哥的狗)

sentences.sentence: Well, I think my chihuahua just killed him...
sentences.translation: 哦，我想我的吉娃娃刚要了它的命……

sentences.sentence: Shortly before their recent wedding they were arrested by the morality police while sitting in their car with their pet chihuahua.
sentences.translation: 这对新婚夫妇在结婚前不久曾被道德警察逮捕，当时他们正和他们的吉娃娃宠物狗一起坐在车里。

sentences.sentence: Many scientists agree that the domestic dog displays more morphological variation than any other known species, thanks to selective breeding by humans.
sentences.translation: 许多科学家都认为，国内的狗更显示形态比任何其他已知的物种变异，人类有选择育种的感谢。

sentences.sentence: Other morphological features have also been identified that are inconsistent with a bird-from-dinosaur theory.
sentences.translation: 其他的形态学特征也被认为与鸟类自恐龙演化的理论不一致。

phrases.translation: [物]电抗成分；虚数部分；无功部分

sentences.sentence: a reactive foreign policy
sentences.translation: 回应式的外交政策

translations.translation: 菲律宾的, 菲律宾人的

sentences.sentence: CMMI certification, she says, would ensure a higher quality of software development and help Philippine software companies compete more effectively, particularly in the international market.
sentences.translation: 她说，CMMI认证将确保更高质量的软件开发，帮助菲律宾的软件公司，特别是在国际市场上，更有效地竞争。

sentences.sentence: Among the outstanding questions is whether victims were killed by Mendoza's or Philippine police bullets during the botched rescue operation and how the negotiation process was carried out.
sentences.translation: 在蹩脚的救援行动期间，遇难者是死于门多萨还是菲律宾警方的子弹，以及他们到底怎样进行的谈判，这些问题到现在依然是个迷。

sentences.sentence: During the trip, the youth met with staff from the Philippine Rural Reconstruction Movement.
sentences.translation: 在旅程中，这班年青人跟「菲律宾乡村重建运动」的人员会面。

sentences.sentence: The first geothermally generated electricity was produced in Larderello, Italy, in 1904.
sentences.translation: 1904年，在意大利的拉德莱罗，首次实现了地热发电。

sentences.sentence: The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.
sentences.translation: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。

sentences.sentence: The comments on webcam sites are rife with anthropomorphism, not surprisingly, and even when this is pointed out, the contributors are often undaunted.
sentences.translation: 不出意外的，在动物直播网站里充满了各种拟人化的评论，虽然已经有人指出，但是那些评论者却从不更改。

phrases.translation: 时间空档；（电视或广播电台的）播放时段

sentences.sentence: Alan dropped another quarter into the slot on the pay phone.
sentences.translation: 艾伦往付费电话的投币口里又塞了一枚 25 分的硬币。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 359 单元

escutcheon
音标：英 /ɪ'skʌtʃ(ə)n; e-/  美 /ɪ'skʌtʃən/
n. 有花纹的盾, 锁眼盖, 孔罩

horticulturalist
n. 园艺家
例句：The progress of the bloom was checked closely by museum horticulturalist Zac Stayton.
博物馆的园艺学家扎克•斯泰顿严密监测着开花的过程。
例句：Father-of-three Mr England, who works as a RHS horticulturalist and lives in Lockleaze, Bristol, was stunned because wild squirrels are usually highly secretive animals.
史蒂夫·英格兰先生有三个孩子，他是皇家园艺学会的园艺师，目前居住在布里斯托尔的Lockleaze。 当时他被眼前的情景惊呆了，因为通常情况下，野生松鼠的行踪高度诡秘。
例句：I'm a professional horticulturalist, and I'm excited about the topic of ornamenting one's garden and teaching others how best to accomplish this.
我是专业的园艺家，我对装饰花园，及教导别人如何完成装饰花园等主题，十分感兴趣。

reunion
音标：英 /riː'juːnjən; -ɪən/
n. 团圆, 重聚
短语：family reunion — 家庭团聚
短语：family reunion dinner — 团圆饭；年夜饭
例句：an annual reunion
一年一度的聚会
例句：a family reunion
家庭聚会
例句：a high-school reunion
高中同学联谊聚会

alphabetically
音标：英 /,ælfe'bɛtɪkli/  美 /,ælfə'bɛtɪkli/
adv. 按字母表顺序地
例句：For example, you could list your records in your report alphabetically.
例如，可以在报告中按字母顺序列出记录。
例句：Some options led to a second list of recipes organized alphabetically or by most recent entry.
一些选项指向按字母顺序或者按最近访问组织的另一个菜谱列表。
例句：You can sort the rows within a table of data according to the data type, allowing you to order by figures — alphabetically and by date.
您还可以根据数据类型对数据表格中的行进行排序，这样便可以按数字、字母和日期进行排序。

carelessly
音标：英 /'kɛəlisli/  美 /'kɛəlisli/
adv. 粗心地；疏忽地
例句：He carelessly left the door unlocked.
他很粗心，没锁上门。
例句："Oh," he said carelessly. "I'm in no hurry to get back."
"哦，"他漫不经心地说道，"我不急着回去。" 

supermodel
音标：美 /'supɚmɑdl/
n. 超级名模
例句：Jeff: If you were a supermodel, I can see why that would be important.
杰夫：如果你是一个超级名模我就明白为什么这很重要。
例句：British supermodel Naomi Campbell has interviewed Venezuela's President Hugo Chavez, describing him as a "rebel angel" who is unafraid to speak his mind but poses no threat to democracy.
英国超级名模娜奥米·坎贝尔日前采访了委内瑞拉总统胡戈·查韦斯，她称查韦斯为“叛逆天使”，因为他完全不惧恐吓，坚持自己的理念。
例句：Some of the celebrities, including actress Eva Mendes and supermodel Cindy Crawford appeared in a "Stars Without Makeup" section in which they were photographed wearing no make-up for their close-ups.
其他一些名人，如女演员伊娃·曼德斯和超级名模辛迪·克劳馥德等出现在“不施粉黛最美人物”单元，这些明星在近距离拍照时不化妆。

brusquely
adv. 唐突地, 粗率地

stubble
音标：英 /'stʌb(ə)l/  美 /'stʌbl/
n. 短须, 麦茬
例句：The stubble was burning in the fields.
残株在田地里燃烧着。

solely
音标：英 /'səʊllɪ/  美 /'solli/
adv. 独自地, 单独地
例句：Scholarships are given solely on the basis of financial need.
奖学金完全是根据经济需要发放的。
例句：I shall hold you solely responsible for anything that goes wrong.
出现任何差错的话，我唯你是问。

flout
音标：英 /flaʊt/  美 /flaʊt/
vt&n. 轻视, 嘲笑
例句：...illegal campers who persist in flouting the law.
…一向无视法律的非法露营者。

chihuahua
音标：英 /tʃɪ'wɑːwə/  美 /tʃɪ'wɑwɑ/
n. 吉娃娃(一种产于墨西哥的狗)
例句：Well, I think my chihuahua just killed him...
哦，我想我的吉娃娃刚要了它的命……
例句：Shortly before their recent wedding they were arrested by the morality police while sitting in their car with their pet chihuahua.
这对新婚夫妇在结婚前不久曾被道德警察逮捕，当时他们正和他们的吉娃娃宠物狗一起坐在车里。

morphological
音标：英 /,mɔːfə'lɒdʒɪkəl/  美 /,mɔrfə'lɑdʒəkəl/
adj. 形态学的
短语：morphological character — 形态特征，形态性状
例句：Many scientists agree that the domestic dog displays more morphological variation than any other known species, thanks to selective breeding by humans.
许多科学家都认为，国内的狗更显示形态比任何其他已知的物种变异，人类有选择育种的感谢。
例句：Other morphological features have also been identified that are inconsistent with a bird-from-dinosaur theory.
其他的形态学特征也被认为与鸟类自恐龙演化的理论不一致。

reactive
音标：英 /rɪ'æktɪv/  美 /rɪ'æktɪv/
adj. 反应的, 反作用的
短语：reactive power — [化]无功功率
短语：reactive power compensation — 无功补偿
短语：reactive dye — 活性染料
短语：reactive current — 无功电流，电抗性电流
短语：reactive dyeing — 活性染料染色
短语：reactive power control — 无效功率控制
短语：reactive diluent — 活性稀释剂
短语：reactive component — [物]电抗成分；虚数部分；无功部分
短语：reactive load — 无功负载；电抗负载
例句：a reactive foreign policy
回应式的外交政策

Philippine
音标：英 /'filipi:n/  美 /'filipi:n/
adj. 菲律宾的, 菲律宾人的
短语：philippine sea — 菲律宾海
短语：philippine islands — 菲律宾群岛
例句：CMMI certification, she says, would ensure a higher quality of software development and help Philippine software companies compete more effectively, particularly in the international market.
她说，CMMI认证将确保更高质量的软件开发，帮助菲律宾的软件公司，特别是在国际市场上，更有效地竞争。
例句：Among the outstanding questions is whether victims were killed by Mendoza's or Philippine police bullets during the botched rescue operation and how the negotiation process was carried out.
在蹩脚的救援行动期间，遇难者是死于门多萨还是菲律宾警方的子弹，以及他们到底怎样进行的谈判，这些问题到现在依然是个迷。
例句：During the trip, the youth met with staff from the Philippine Rural Reconstruction Movement.
在旅程中，这班年青人跟「菲律宾乡村重建运动」的人员会面。

geothermally
adj. 地热的
例句：The first geothermally generated electricity was produced in Larderello, Italy, in 1904.
1904年，在意大利的拉德莱罗，首次实现了地热发电。

inflow
音标：英 /'ɪnfləʊ/  美 /'ɪnflo/
n. 流入, 流入物
短语：water inflow — 涌水量；进水量
短语：capital inflow — 资本流入
短语：cash inflow — 现金流入；现金流入量
短语：net inflow — 入超净额
例句：The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.
瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。

subfreezing
adj. 低于冰点的

anthropomorphism
音标：英 /,ænθrəpə'mɔːfɪz(ə)m/  美 /,ænθrəpə'mɔrfɪzəm/
n. 拟人论,拟人观
例句：The comments on webcam sites are rife with anthropomorphism, not surprisingly, and even when this is pointed out, the contributors are often undaunted.
不出意外的，在动物直播网站里充满了各种拟人化的评论，虽然已经有人指出，但是那些评论者却从不更改。

slot
音标：英 /slɒt/  美 /slɑt/
n. 狭缝；空位
短语：time slot — 时间空档；（电视或广播电台的）播放时段
短语：slot machine — 自动售贷机
短语：slot antenna — 缝隙天线；槽孔天线
短语：key slot — n. 键槽
短语：single slot — 单插槽；单翼缝
短语：slot width — 齿缝宽度
短语：stator slot — 定子槽
短语：card slot — 板槽，插卡槽
短语：slot wedge — 槽楔；槽边缘
短语：expansion slot — 扩充槽，扩充插槽
短语：rotor slot — 转子线槽
例句：Alan dropped another quarter into the slot on the pay phone.
艾伦往付费电话的投币口里又塞了一枚 25 分的硬币。

mansion
音标：英 /'mænʃ(ə)n/  美 /'mænʃən/
n. 大厦, 官邸
短语：mansion house — 大厦之屋，民信大厦；府邸
短语：executive mansion — n. 白宫；州长官邸
例句：a beautiful country mansion
漂亮的乡村宅第
